method: Read rendered official overview, specs, guidelines and accessibility pages in browser

observations.tabs: Named destinations, keyboard navigation, 48 CSS pixel targets; support panel relationships using WAI ARIA tab pattern
observations.sliders: Named slider handles, arrow and Home/End adjustment, distinguish range handles
observations.badges: Expose numeric information and notification context to assistive technology
observations.button-groups: 2dp gaps, 48x48 targets, arrows navigate, Space/Enter activates; container is not a focus stop
